Root Further is not merely a name — it is the spirit every Sunner aspires to: always looking deeper in every context and never ceasing to create, expanding oneself to overcome self-imposed limits. Borrowing imagery from color theory, from just three primary colors — red, yellow and blue — the boundless creativity of each individual can produce an almost infinite number of shades, each representing breakthrough and limitless creativity.

A movement to recognize and thank colleagues — held for the first time for all Sunners. Launching in November 2025, it encourages Sun* people to share recognition and thanks with colleagues on the system announced by the organizers. This will be material for the Heads Council to reference when selecting award recipients.
The Community Standards are built to ensure a civil, safe and positive environment for everyone taking part in the Sun* Kudos recognition and thank-you movement.
Content found to match any of the violation criteria below will be labelled Spam and automatically hidden by the system.

string-array.name: cs_criteria
string-array.item: Using profane, abusive, offensive or defamatory language.
Referring to political, religious or gender-discrimination topics.
Containing specific figures (revenue, contracts, KPIs, clients, project codes, account numbers…).
Mentioning partner, client or external organization names.
Containing personal information (email, phone number, address, family details).
Sending 3+ messages with similar content in a short time.
Kudos content too short (under 30 characters) with no context (\"Thanks a lot\", \"Thanks\", \"Good job!\").
Sending to too many people/groups in a short time (under 3s per message).
Spam wording (only characters such as \".\", \",\", \"...\", or characters with no content).
Abnormal spike in \"hearts\" (relative to average user behaviour).

resources.string: Sunner commits to protecting information. Every member is responsible for keeping shared content confidential on the system.
Information security: All information Sunners share is kept confidential on the system.
Sharing scope: All HR and project information on the system is confidential. Please share only within Sun*.
Support: For any questions, please contact the SAA organizing representative on Slack — duong.thi.thuy.an.
